import numpy as np
ax = ax1
lines, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
new_labels = []
for line, label in zip(lines, labels):
    y_data = line.get_ydata()
    x_data = line.get_xdata()
    mask = (x_data >= 200) & (x_data <= 450)
    if len(x_data[mask]) > 0:
        w200 = np.interp(200, x_data, y_data)
        w450 = np.interp(450, x_data, y_data)
        delta_w = w200 - w450
        new_labels.append(f"{label} (ΔW: {delta_w:.2f} wt%)")
    else:
        new_labels.append(label)
ax.legend(new_labels, loc='best')
